script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
FILES=(
  "memory.html"
  "assets/js/memory-graph.js"
  "assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js"
)
for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  API="https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/${f}?ref=main"
  TMP="/tmp/_xm_gal_$(basename "$f")"
  curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" -H "User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync" "$API" -o "$TMP"
  sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$TMP" "/var/www/xinmo-site/${f}"
  rm -f "$TMP"
  echo "SYNCED: $f"
done
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/memory.html?t=$(date +%s)" | grep -E "memory-graph(-3d)?\.js"
